verdicts.reason: A shrinks the headline and drops it into the lower part of the canvas (block centered around 63% of the height). That leaves a large dead area at the top, the layout is lopsided, and the type looks timid for a single-message poster. B re-wraps to three lines at a strong size that fills the width with even side margins and centers it vertically, keeping the original's calm, centered feel. Its only small flaw is that the margins are a little tight relative to the original's generous white space.
